summary.text: Disciplined, systems-oriented Route-to-Market Analyst who leads a team of 3 across 3 entities in West Java. Known for turning inconsistent field processes into standardized, measurable frameworks, including a Call Frequency Management system across 32 depots and the removal of 12,000+ suspicious outlets through data-driven anomaly detection. Combines a data science foundation with hands-on field and stakeholder experience, so analysis becomes action that depots actually adopt. Guided by "Quam plurimi et quam aptissimi", aiming to continuously learn and drive lasting operational impact.

experience.company: Tirta Utama Abadi (Danone Distributor, West Java)
details: Detected anomalies in transaction patterns and geolocation data to deactivate 12,000+ potentially fraudulent outlets, cleaning the outlet base that all coverage and incentive decisions rely on.

Replaced inconsistent visit practices with one standardized, field-tailored Call Frequency Management framework across all 32 depots in West Java, driving double-digit profit growth at nearly every depot.
Lead a team of 3 across 3 entities, keeping salesman territories and sales fundamentals healthy and well maintained.
Rebuilt daily sprint dashboards from scratch, giving every depot live performance data with zero manual compilation.
Automated market-potential and distance-to-active-outlet analysis for new outlet openings, saving the team ~8.6 hours per month.
Analyze monthly fleet requirements per depot and channel by combining sales targets with the previous month's fleet data, ensuring delivery capacity matches expected demand.
Conduct market analysis, including trade economics, to guide coverage, outlet-opening, and channel decisions across depots.
Automated manual reporting workflows in Excel, eliminating approximately 12 hours of manual data entry per week.
Partnered with Finance, Sales, and Operations to design systems and standardize SOPs, replacing fragmented department-level practices with consistent cross-functional standards.
Drove sales through direct customer engagement, consistently working toward and achieving monthly sales targets.
Assessed customer credit applications using 7C and 5S principles, safeguarding receivables quality while keeping approval turnaround efficient.
Followed up daily on overdue customer accounts through structured negotiation and payment-commitment tracking to secure repayment.
Led a 34-member council across 10 divisions, introducing KPI-based performance tracking to establish clear accountability per division.
Designed school-wide programs subsequently adopted as permanent initiatives by the administration.
Led outreach campaigns across 12 feeder schools to increase student engagement and recruitment.
Established weekly inter-division coordination meetings, reducing miscommunication and missed deadlines.
